Use this as the handoff for the next conversation:

KoreLumina Knowledge Operations — Lumina Design System Extraction Handoff
Mission Continuation — Finish the Remaining Extraction Completely
You are continuing the Knowledge Operations → Lumina Design System extraction and refinement in KoreLumina.
You are acting as the Lead Systems Architect and Principal Engineer.
This is not an MVP task.
The objective is to finish the remaining Knowledge Operations extraction completely, preserve the certified UI contract, eliminate remaining Knowledge-local duplication where appropriate, and leave the Learning side fully migrated and production-grade.
Do not restart the architecture.
Do not redesign the workspace.
Do not wire backend/runtime/persistence.
This remains a frontend/design-system extraction and visual-contract preservation task only.

Current Repository State
Repository:
kore20lllc-netizen/korelumina
Branch:
inspect/runtime-certified-main
Current verified pushed HEAD:
2455ee2b4aee98ea8eddba48f998e056592a0f56
Commit:
refactor(knowledge): adopt Lumina flagship panel in educational corpus explorer
GitHub verification confirms this commit contains:


FlagshipPanel → LuminaFlagshipPanel


removal of the redundant Corpus Explorer cardHighlight

no unrelated modifications.


Local terminal was clean after push.
Before continuing, verify:
Bashcd /Users/erictouko/dev/korelumina

git branch --show-current
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
Expected:
inspect/runtime-certified-main
2455ee2b4aee98ea8eddba48f998e056592a0f56
and empty status.

Non-Negotiable Workflow
UI is the contract
The extraction order remains:


Preserve and complete the certified UI.


Migrate Knowledge-local presentation wrappers into Lumina primitives.


Visually validate every migration.


Only after the entire surface inventory is understood, extract reusable nested-card/surface contracts into Lumina.


Remove obsolete Knowledge-local presentation code only after zero-consumer verification.


Never redesign around implementation convenience.
Never weaken the UI to make extraction easier.

One milestone only
For every remaining surface:


Inspect committed source through the GitHub connector first.


Establish the architectural responsibility.


Make the smallest safe local change.


Run:


Bashnpm run build


User visually validates.


Only after explicit green:


git add


git commit


git push




Verify pushed commit through GitHub before starting the next milestone.


Never commit merely because the build passes.
next does not mean visual approval.
green means visual approval.

Editing Rules
Do not ask the user to manually edit files.
Use exact terminal automation only.
Preferred safe pattern:
Bashpython - <<'PY'
...
PY
with exact-string counts that fail closed.
Use:
Bashgit diff --check
npm run build
git diff -- <file>
git status --short
before visual validation.
Do not batch multiple unrelated surfaces.

GitHub Requirement
The user explicitly requires GitHub plugin usage during this reconstruction.
For committed source, existing architecture, and pushed milestones:


inspect via GitHub.fetch_file


verify commits via GitHub.fetch_commit


use GitHub as the committed source of truth


Use terminal only for:


local branch/HEAD/status


local modifications


builds


runtime visual inspection


commit/push


Do not claim a pushed change exists until GitHub verifies it.

Certified Baseline
The original certified Knowledge Operations UI was green before extraction at:
66a4b19c05b1092cfcdae3ee8cea2a16a0e46810
fix(knowledge): synchronize navigator with section visibility
The following behaviors are part of the contract and must remain unchanged:


Production navigator section tracking


Flow Engine selection semantics


Inspector explicit reveal behavior


Inspector close/focus semantics


accessible tabs


lifecycle tab forcing for timeline selection


persistent back-to-top


cross-surface selections


responsive behavior


accessibility polish


fixture-only data


Any runtime or behavioral regression stops extraction until root cause is established.

Lumina Outer Panel Primitive
The reusable outer panel has already been extracted:
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/lumina/workspace/primitives/LuminaFlagshipPanel.tsx
It is the canonical outer flagship shell.
Its visual contract includes:


rounded 30px shell


electric cyan/blue border


cyan inset ring


blue glow


premium glass background


flagship header


amber title treatment


optional toolbar


forwarded <section> props


Do not recreate outer panel styling locally.
Remaining outer FlagshipPanel consumers should migrate to this primitive.

Important Contour Rule
A critical visual refinement was discovered during Learning extraction.
The workspace uses two visually distinct contour levels:
Outer flagship panel
Canonicalized in:
LuminaFlagshipPanel
This is already extracted into Lumina.
Inner/nested cards
These are not yet fully extracted into Lumina.
Some nested cards currently use Knowledge-local:
flagshipAppearance.card
flagshipAppearance.innerPanel
flagshipAppearance.innerSurface
flagshipAppearance.inspectorMetric
flagshipAppearance.inspectorDetailCard
and some surface-specific classes.
The user specifically expects the nested surfaces to carry a clear electric-blue contour, not weak cyan-gray borders.
Do not consider design-system extraction complete until the nested-card/surface contour system has been evaluated and extracted appropriately.
However:
Do not prematurely create a generic Lumina nested-card primitive until all remaining Learning surfaces are inspected.
We need the complete variant inventory first.

Double-Contour Lesson
Do not blindly stack:


border


inset ring


custom highlight


selected ring


additional surface-specific highlight


This caused visible double contours.
FlagshipCard already contains its own built-in top highlight.
Corpus Explorer also manually rendered:
TypeScript<div className={flagshipAppearance.cardHighlight} />
which was redundant.
The first selected Corpus card also showed concentric border/ring treatment because flagshipAppearance.card and cardSelected stacked rings.
The validated Corpus fix was:


remove the redundant explicit cardHighlight


apply selected && "ring-0" locally


Do not generalize that fix globally without inspecting all consumers.

Completed Production Migrations
Production-side FlagshipPanel extraction is complete.

Remaining Learning Work
The remaining known FlagshipPanel consumers are:
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge/learning/states/EducationalStateSurface.tsx
and:
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge/learning/composition/EducationalCommandCenter.tsx
EducationalCommandCenter.tsx historically contains two FlagshipPanel blocks and should remain last because it is the highest-risk Learning surface.
Before editing anything, refresh the actual remaining inventory from the current clean HEAD:
Bashgrep -R -n \
'presentation/FlagshipPanel\|<FlagshipPanel\|</FlagshipPanel>' \
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge/learning \
| sort
Do not assume the historical inventory if the code says otherwise.

Recommended Completion Order
Milestone 1 — Educational State Surface
Inspect through GitHub first:
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge/learning/states/EducationalStateSurface.tsx
Determine:

Build.
Visually validate every represented state.
Commit only after green.

Milestone 2 — Educational Command Center
Inspect through GitHub after State Surface is pushed.
File:
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge/learning/composition/EducationalCommandCenter.tsx
This is higher risk because it contains two flagship shells and likely composition/state orchestration.
Do not replace both blindly.
Understand each panel responsibility first.
Potentially migrate one panel at a time if their behavior/visual surfaces are sufficiently independent.
Preserve all:


workspace orchestration


selection state


inspector behavior


section navigation


tab state


educational timeline interactions


artifact selection

Build and visually validate before commit.

After All FlagshipPanel Consumers Are Gone
Only after:
Bashgrep -R -n \
'presentation/FlagshipPanel\|<FlagshipPanel\|</FlagshipPanel>' \
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge \
returns no legitimate Knowledge consumers should removal be considered.
Do not delete learning/presentation/FlagshipPanel.tsx earlier.

Final Design-System Extraction Phase
This is required to completely finish the task.
After all outer panel consumers migrate, inventory the Knowledge-local presentation system, especially:
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge/learning/presentation/flagshipAppearance.ts
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge/learning/presentation/FlagshipCard.tsx
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge/learning/presentation/FlagshipTabs.tsx
Determine which styles are:

Examples likely include:


nested premium card shell

possibly tabs if their visual/interaction contract generalizes


Knowledge-specific
Examples may include:


governance labels

inspector-specific semantic states


domain-specific badges and metadata treatments


Do not move domain semantics into Lumina.

Required Inner-Card Extraction
The current task is not complete until the nested electric-blue card/surface contour has a reusable Lumina contract where appropriate.
Potential target architecture should be decided only after inventory, but likely direction is something like:
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/lumina/workspace/primitives/LuminaFlagshipCard.tsx
or another appropriately named shared nested-surface primitive.
It must account for validated states such as:


default


interactive


selected


possibly article/non-button rendering


single clean contour


no duplicate highlight


accessible focus


hover elevation


reduced-motion behavior


Do not simply copy the current FlagshipCard wholesale.
The current FlagshipCard contains both:


Knowledge-local appearance dependencies


a built-in top highlight


and some surfaces historically added a second highlight manually.
The extracted Lumina version must have a single deliberate contour/highlight contract.

Final Cleanup Sequence
After Lumina nested primitives are created and visually validated:


Migrate one Knowledge consumer at a time.


Build after every migration.


Visual green after every migration.


Commit/push each logical milestone.


Verify through GitHub.


Then audit:
Bashgrep -R -n \
'FlagshipPanel\|FlagshipCard\|flagshipAppearance' \
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge
Classify every remaining reference.
Do not remove flagshipAppearance until all reusable parts have been extracted and the remaining fields are proven Knowledge-specific.
If the file becomes Knowledge-specific only, rename/restructure it in a later isolated ticket rather than deleting blindly.

Final Acceptance Criteria
The task is completely finished only when all of the following are true:


No Knowledge surface uses the obsolete local FlagshipPanel.


All outer flagship shells use LuminaFlagshipPanel.


The reusable nested electric-blue card/surface contract has been extracted into Lumina where appropriate.


No duplicated contour/highlight implementations remain where a Lumina primitive should own them.


Knowledge-specific semantic styles remain local.


No double contours exist.


No weak nested contours remain on certified premium surfaces.


All Production surfaces remain visually unchanged.


All Learning surfaces remain visually unchanged or intentionally upgraded and explicitly user-approved.


All interactions still work.


All accessibility behavior remains intact.


Responsive behavior remains intact.


npm run build is green.


Final grep confirms obsolete wrappers have zero consumers.


Obsolete presentation files are removed only after zero-consumer proof.


Final branch is clean.


Every completed milestone is pushed and verified on GitHub.



Never Do
Do not:


wire backend/runtime/API/persistence


introduce real data


redesign Knowledge Operations


flatten the premium visual hierarchy


weaken the electric-blue contour


globally change flagshipAppearance because one surface has a visual issue


remove selected-state visual semantics


remove focus rings


blindly combine border + inset ring + extra highlight

delete local presentation components before zero-consumer verification


modify shared Lumina components speculatively



Immediate Next Action
Start by verifying the clean current state and inspecting:
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge/learning/states/EducationalStateSurface.tsx
through GitHub at:
2455ee2b4aee98ea8eddba48f998e056592a0f56
Then perform only the next safe migration milestone.
Do not touch EducationalCommandCenter until EducationalStateSurface is green, committed, pushed, and GitHub-verified.

The overarching goal is no longer merely “replace FlagshipPanel.”
The task is to finish the complete Knowledge → Lumina visual-system extraction, including the outer flagship shell, the reusable nested electric-blue contour system, cleanup of obsolete local wrappers, and final zero-regression certification.
